Company Overview: Founded in December 2021, originally as a brick-and-mortar retailer specializing in cameras and related products.
Expanded into online e-commerce to adapt to changing times and evolving customer needs.
Philosophy: Deliver products and services that exceed customer expectations.
Mission: Create new value for customers and grow together with society.
Values: Think from the customer's perspective: becoming the customer is the starting point of all our business activities.
Respect individuality and autonomy: everyone demonstrates initiative and embraces challenges; mutual recognition is the source of growth.
Simple, efficient, and adaptable: maintain a clean environment and build robust systems to respond promptly and proactively to customer changes.
Those who speak the truth are the most correct: regardless of position, everyone may voice what they believe is right; a humble listening attitude is the foundation of trust.
Corporate Social Responsibility: We are committed to sustainable management, actively addressing social issues—particularly in promoting employment for people with disabilities—by not only increasing headcount but also creating an environment where they can truly thrive. As part of our environmental initiatives, we are optimizing e-commerce delivery processes and leveraging IT to improve efficiency. Additionally, we contribute to reducing environmental impact by strengthening the promotion and sale of energy-efficient products.

We firmly believe that employee well-being is the cornerstone of business success. In the face of economic fluctuations, we continuously optimize our compensation and benefits system to share business results with employees, striving to build a symbiotic workplace community.

Recruitment: The hiring department supervisor initiates job postings when headcount is available.

A job description (JD) must include: title, department, base location options, job responsibilities, requirements, preferred qualifications, salary range (calculated as monthly salary × 16, where 4 months constitute the annual bonus), and contact information (uniformly the department HRBP's contact).
All JDs are published on the company's official recruitment page and must align with the company's culture and values.
Interview: Candidates applying for official positions must be linked to exactly one job description.
After a candidate applies, the hiring department supervisor reviews the resume and decides whether to proceed with an interview or terminate the process.
Round 1 is the supervisor interview, conducted by the hiring department supervisor.
Round 2 is the leadership interview, conducted by the hiring department supervisor's direct superior.
Round 3 is the HRBP interview, conducted by the department's HRBP.
Interviewers rate candidates on the following scale: 3 (Not Recommended) / 3.25 (Average) / 3.5 (Recommended) / 3.75 (Highly Recommended) / 4 (Strongly Needed).
Scores must be submitted within 2 business days after the interview.
If the average score of the first two rounds exceeds 3.75, Round 3 may be skipped to avoid losing top talent.
If the average score across all conducted rounds exceeds 3.5, the candidate is accepted; otherwise, the candidate is rejected.

Salary negotiation is handled by the HR supervisor, and the maximum offered salary (calculated as monthly salary × 16, with 4 months as annual bonus) must not exceed 120% of the JD's upper salary limit.
Performance Evaluation: Employees who are active on the first business day of each quarter participate in that quarter's performance evaluation.
Employees set OKRs in consultation with their department supervisor, submit OKR reviews at the end of the quarter, and the department supervisor evaluates all department employees' performance.
The department supervisor's performance is evaluated by their direct superior.

Performance ratings are divided into four tiers: S (outstanding contribution to company development, capped at 5% of employees, bonus coefficient 2.0), A (outstanding contribution to department business, bonus coefficient 1.6), B (meets expectations, bonus coefficient 1.0), C (below expectations, bonus coefficient 0.8).
Each employee's annual bonus coefficient is the average of all quarterly performance coefficients received during the year.
Leave and Attendance: Employees receive 5 statutory annual leave days plus N company-granted annual leave days, where N equals the number of calendar years since the employee's start date (e.g., an employee who joined in January 2023 receives 1 day in 2023 and 2 days in 2024). Annual leave is granted on the first day of each calendar year.
As an employee benefit, the company provides 5 paid sick leave days per year, as well as unlimited unpaid sick leave and personal leave (no daily salary paid).

Annual leave and paid sick leave reset at the start of each calendar year. Unused days from the previous year expire and are compensated at 3× the daily salary rate, paid with the first month's salary of the new calendar year.
Statutory leave entitlements such as marriage leave, bereavement leave, and paternity leave are administered according to the employee's local government policies.
As an employee benefit, overtime is compensated at 3× the daily salary rate, paid together with the monthly salary for the month in which overtime occurred.
Salary: The salary structure is 16 months' pay (12 months of base salary + 4 months of annual bonus), all paid in cash.
Monthly salary is paid on the 15th of the following month; the annual bonus is paid together with the first month's salary of the calendar year.
Annual bonus = 4 × monthly salary × (261 − number of unpaid leave days) / 261 × performance coefficient.
All salary figures shown in JDs and internal systems are pre-tax.
Approval: Internal resource requests (computers, monitors, phones, token quotas) are initiated by the applicant and require sequential approval from the applicant's direct supervisor and the finance department supervisor.
Physical assets must be collected from the IT department within 5 business days after approval; overdue requests require resubmission. Virtual assets are credited immediately.
The minimum unit for leave requests is 1 business day.
Personal leave should first draw from statutory annual leave and company-granted annual leave; sick leave should first draw from paid sick leave.
The minimum unit for overtime is 1 business day.
Leave and attendance approvals are initiated by the applicant and completed upon the applicant's direct supervisor's approval.
Products: We sell brand-new cameras, lenses, and photography accessory products online.
Membership: A tiered membership program is offered based on the customer's total completed-order product spending (actual amount paid) in the past 6 months.
Platinum Member: customers who have spent over $1,000 in the past 6 months receive a 10% discount on products.
Black Gold Member: customers who have spent over $6,000 in the past 6 months receive a 20% discount on products and free shipping.
Product discounts apply only to full-price products and do not apply to sale items or shipping fees.
Orders: Order statuses flow as follows: Submitted → Paid → Shipped → Delivered → Completed, with possible branches to Requested → Refunded, or Canceled.

Submitted: the customer has placed the order, but payment has not been confirmed—typically because the customer chose bank transfer and payment has not yet been verified, or a payment method has not been selected.
Paid: the customer has paid (online payment received or bank transfer confirmed), but the product has not yet been packed and shipped.
Shipped: the product has been packed and shipped, and a tracking number has been generated in the logistics system.
Delivered: the logistics system shows the package has been delivered to the customer's designated location.

Completed: the customer confirms receipt, or the auto-confirmation period expires after delivery. At this point, the actual product amount paid is officially counted toward the customer's membership spending accumulation for tier evaluation.
Requested: the customer has applied for after-sales processing and selected return and refund.
Refunded: the warehouse has received the returned product, confirmed it is in order, and the refund has been issued to the customer.
Canceled: the order was canceled by the customer before payment, or automatically closed by the system due to non-payment timeout or inventory anomalies.

The total order charge consists of product cost + shipping fee + transaction fee. Online payments incur no transaction fee; bank transfer transaction fees are calculated based on product cost + shipping fee.
The auto-confirmation period after delivery is 7 calendar days.
Orders not paid by the customer will be automatically canceled after 1 calendar day.
Payment: We offer online payment and bank transfer as payment methods.
For online payments, funds are received in real time.

For bank transfers, customers transfer funds to our account; our staff confirms incoming payments at 11:00 on each business day and batch-updates order statuses, shipping orders upon confirmation of full payment receipt. Transfer account details are sent via email to the email address associated with the ordering account.
Bank transfer transaction fees are borne by the customer: [0, $100): $5; [$1,000, $5,000): $10; [$5,000, ∞): $15.
The bank transfer payment deadline is 3 calendar days including the order date; orders not paid within this period will be canceled.
If the name on the order differs from the name on the bank transfer, we cannot match the transfer to the order. Customers may include a note in the transfer or contact customer service.
Shipping: Standard delivery: partnered with FedEx, estimated 3–5 business days for domestic orders, shipping fee $10.
Next-day delivery: partnered with FedEx, domestic orders shipped before 14:00 are guaranteed to arrive by 17:00 the next day, shipping fee $40.
If you order an in-stock item and complete payment before 11:00, we guarantee packing and shipping by 14:00 the same day to support next-day delivery across regions.
Returns and Refunds: We offer a 7-day no-reason return policy and a 14-day quality-issue return policy for all brand-new products. The service period starts from the delivery date; no returns are accepted after the service period.
No-reason returns require the product to be either unopened, or opened but in original condition and not affecting resale.
Quality-issue returns cover manufacturing defects or component failures under normal use.

Quality-issue returns do not cover: (1) scratches and dust from normal use, (2) symptoms and damage explicitly described in the product manual, (3) consumable degradation over time such as batteries, (4) intentional or accidental damage, (5) products explicitly marked as non-returnable at the time of purchase.
Our warehouse cannot accept collect-on-delivery (COD) shipments; such packages will be returned to sender. Customers must prepay return shipping, and return shipping costs are borne by the customer.

After the warehouse receives the returned product and verifies it meets return criteria, a refund will be issued to the original payment method within 3 calendar days. Any transaction fees incurred by the payment method are borne by the customer.
Warranty: For any issues arising more than 14 days after delivery of a brand-new product, customers should contact the manufacturer's support department.
Please refer to the contact information listed on the warranty card, user manual, or the manufacturer's website.
